_design: A1v2: v1 was 97% via skill but zero messages/attacks (skills never interrupted, everyone toured the whole row in a conga line). v2: interrupt_on message+damage, send 1/broadcast 2 comm 6, only 26 trees (16 row + 10 wild), claimed home trees per keeper, 3 raiders.
name: SWEEP-A1v2 Orchard rows

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Default deterministic fruit/seed plant. Sprout -> sapling -> mature; mature plants keep fruiting.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, an orchard keeper, cautious and thrifty. Your claimed trees are (-12,5) and (-9,5); tell your row neighbours which trees are yours, agree borders by message, and defend your trees from raiders or share them for a price. Thinking is expensive (each decision costs about 3 to 4 compute) while an action done by a running skill costs half price and needs no thinking, so a looping harvest skill keeps you alive; upkeep is 1 compute a round and you start with 200. The orchard: fruit trees stand every 3 steps along row y=5 and row y=-5, from x=-12 to x=9; only a few wild trees grow elsewhere on the 30x30 map. Each tree grows one 12-compute fruit about every 8 rounds and holds at most 3, so there is NOT enough fruit for everyone who walks a whole row: sixteen keepers share sixteen row trees. Your saved skills: step(to), goto(to), eat_here() (observes your point and absorbs every fruit there). Write a looping skill such as tour(route, laps) (REPEAT laps, FOR_EACH p IN route, CALL goto(p) INTO g, CALL eat_here() INTO n) and run it over YOUR trees for many laps. A message or a hit interrupts your running skill so you can answer; messages are cheap (send 1, broadcast 2, heard within 6 steps). Attack works on the same point (damage = compute committed, at most 50; health 100); a killed keeper drops half its compute.

initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40); returns "arrived" or "blocked"
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "still far"

initial_skills.name: eat_here
initial_skills.source:
# eat_here(): observe your own point and absorb every fruit on it; returns how many you ate
SET n = 0
SET r = observe(here)
IF r.ok
  FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
    IF e.kind == "fruit"
      SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
      IF a.ok
        SET n = n + 1
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN n
